page.overview:
What is Live at Grimey's?

Live at Grimey's was recorded live on June 12, 2008, at The Basement, a venue beneath Grimey's New & Preloved Music in Nashville, Tennessee, just before their appearance at the Bonnaroo Music Festival. It was released on November 26, 2010. It was released on both CD and vinyl, and is available at independent record stores, as well as the band's website. In its first week after release, the EP sold around 3,000 copies.

As opposed to all of Metallica releases from Death Magnetic onwards, Live at Grimey's is its first release since the band's live album S&M (1999) to use the original Metallica logo rather than the more slanted one used for Death Magnetic.

It is a notable release as it shows the furthest Metallica has gotten into the song "The Frayed Ends of Sanity" ever in a live performance, having often played a part of the introduction to the song in their live shows but never having played it in its entirety.
